project: Secant to Tangent at x=2 for f(x)=x squared

V02Scene.title: Secant tends to tangent at x=2

cues.text: Watch the secant through x equals 2 and x equals 3 on f of x equals x squared. Its slope is 5.
Now shrink the second point toward 2. The refined secant reads 4.25 and lands on the tangent of slope 4.
